skill_name: Write a biographical summary about a Nobel Prize winner of your choice.
workflow: Malala Yousafzai is a 19-year-old Pakistani human rights advocate who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2014, making her the youngest Nobel Prize laureate in history. Born in Swat Valley, Pakistan, she is a passionate advocate for girls’ education and has been campaigning for this cause since the age of 11.
